purpose: Qualify stable geometry/owner/operator binding independently of physical amount remap
native_runtime: Actual authenticated imports of DECMesh, Cells and FiniteDiffSolver in existing BETSE venv; empty Cells.__init__ pass bypassed for normalized parameters; no arithmetic hooks
generation_scope: Explicit seed clouds or actual seeded single-cell point generator, native init_mesh plus selected cell/environment pipeline; no YAML/lattice-image/full make_world or solver/cut execution
seed_ownership: Explicit original/retained/removed IDs; no production RNG consumption, implicit removal or cross-generation coordinate matching

geometry_semantics.measures: Native radial membrane pie volumes differ from signed CCW polygon area*height; pre-shrink vor_sa remains the DEC control area
geometry_semantics.dual: Native closest-midpoint paired edges; centroid duals need not be orthogonal; tri_sa_o is a repeated reference face area with declared owner, not a physical partition
geometry_semantics.contacts: Explicit reciprocal contact IDs, opposed normals and equal interface areas; contact edges remain distinct from primal field edges
geometry_semantics.environment: C-order uniform MAC grid; nearest owner maps explicit; native true_ecm_vol is membrane surface*gap/2 at occupied sites, uniform volume elsewhere

operators.primal: D0 oriented endpoint incidence; D1 CCW face boundary; positive measures and exact D1D0
operators.closed: Native btype2 = -D0.T weighted divergence; constant/component nullspaces and area-weighted conservation
operators.interior_rows: Native btype1 zeros boundary output rows; does not impose input boundary potentials; world requests core-only and missing auxiliary paths fail
operators.inverse: Source factorized pseudoinverse product retained separately from Cells density pseudoinverse; not generally a right inverse
operators.grid: Native value row = identity/delta^2, flux missing-neighbor stencil; source asymmetric corner precedence retained
operators.grid_nullspace: Native default pinv may retain a spurious constant mode on 8x8/16x16; compatible_gauge uses the declared constant nullspace and requires finite zero-sum RHS
operators.gauge: Arithmetic-zero potential per disconnected component; density RHS area-weighted compatible; no silent physical source projection
operators.xy: Literal source grad_xy mixing only; no guaranteed Cartesian gradient or centroid-dual continuum Laplacian claim

reference: Independent stdlib polygon/owner/contact/incidence/stencil loops and pivoted gauge elimination; native topology is an explicit input, not independent Delaunay generation
scope_limits: No material/charge/ATP/water remap or physical geometry evolution
No cut execution, solver continuation or checkpoint migration
No full-tissue, mechanical-energy or continuum centroid-dual convergence claim
Static CPU/JAX numerics; geometry generation and all runtime state remain caller-owned
